method: Built-in image_gen mouth donors; deterministic mouth-only compositing onto cleaned original rest sprites; identical alpha and 448x512 canvas.

In each of the seven occupied panels change ONLY the lips: open mouth slightly mid-word, restrained calm speech. Keep nose, cheeks, chin silhouette, eyes, headscarf, pose, hands, clothing, every other detail unchanged. Preserve all expressions and gaze directions. Last cell remains empty. Genuinely transparent background. Do not redraw or reposition the figures. Output canvas 1792x1024.

Preserve transparent background. Output same 1344x512 canvas, 3 equal 448x512 cells. No labels.
